# Text Wrapping Test

| Feature | Description | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------|
| Auto-wrap | Text in cells automatically wraps to multiple lines when content exceeds column width | This ensures content is readable |
| Row height | Row height expands to accommodate wrapped text | Dynamic calculation |
| Alignment | Text alignment is preserved even with wrapped content | Left, center, right |
